definitions.explanation: A person who currently holds or maintains something — typically a record, championship, license, or other formal status. Often preceded by what is held.

examples.japanese: {世界記録|せかいきろく}{保持者|ほじしゃ}。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧{保持者|ほじしゃ}だ。
⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧{保持者|ほじしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}った→破る：02321_yaburu⟧。
examples.english: The current champion defeated the longtime title holder.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{保持|ほじ}→保持：05618_hoji⟧ (maintaining, holding) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Almost always used as a suffix-like noun in compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- {世界記録|せかいきろく}{保持者|ほじしゃ}: world record holder
- ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧{保持者|ほじしゃ}: title holder
- ⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧{保持者|ほじしゃ}: certification holder
- ⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧{保持者|ほじしゃ}: license holder
- ⟦{株式|かぶしき}→株式：04772_kabushiki⟧{保持者|ほじしゃ}: shareholder (rarer than ⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{所有者|しょゆうしゃ}→所有者：21212_shoyuusha⟧: owner — for property rather than records or status
- ⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧: owner — colloquial, for everyday possessions
